title: Dutch supermarkets sell more organic products despite little promotion in circulars
title_zh: 尽管荷兰超市在宣传册上很少提及有机产品，但其有机产品销量却更高。
description: People have bought organic products more often in recent years at major Dutch supermarket chains, but the stores still promote them too little in their advertising circulars.
description_zh: 近年来，人们在荷兰大型连锁超市购买有机产品的频率越来越高，但这些超市在广告宣传册中对有机产品的宣传力度仍然不够。

title: Extreme heat widens educational inequality at Dutch primary schools, study finds
title_zh: 研究发现，极端高温加剧了荷兰小学教育不平等现象。
description: Primary-school pupils from disadvantaged backgrounds are disproportionately affected by extreme heat caused by climate change, a new study has found.
description_zh: 一项新的研究发现，来自弱势背景的小学生受气候变化导致的极端高温的影响尤为严重。

title: Growth in home sales stalls; First-time buyers buying fewer homes
title_zh: 房屋销售增长停滞；首次购房者购买房屋数量减少
description: Home sales in the Netherlands stopped growing in the third quarter, with just over 77,000 properties changing hands, roughly matching the total from a year prior.
description_zh: 荷兰房屋销售在第三季度停止增长，仅有 77,000 多套房产易手，与去年同期基本持平。

title: Saturday starts frosty across the Netherlands after overnight lows of -4°C to -7°C
title_zh: 周六荷兰各地气温骤降至零下4至7摄氏度，早晨将迎来霜冻天气。
description: On Saturday, temperatures started well below freezing in many places and are expected to stay near or just above zero under a stiff southwest wind.
description_zh: 周六，许多地方气温远低于冰点，预计在强劲的西南风作用下，气温将保持在零度左右或略高于零度。

title: Dutch Neo-Nazi sentenced in Germany for glorifying Hitler
title_zh: 一名荷兰新纳粹分子因歌颂希特勒在德国被判刑。
description: A court in Münster has sentenced Dutch neo-Nazi Stefan Wijkamp, 59, to an eight-month suspended prison term for glorifying Adolf Hitler and inciting hatred.
description_zh: 明斯特一家法院判处 59 岁的荷兰新纳粹分子斯特凡·维坎普 (Stefan Wijkamp) 八个月缓刑，罪名是美化阿道夫·希特勒和煽动仇恨。

title: Premises evacuated amid days-long fire at agricultural firm silo
title_zh: 农业公司筒仓发生持续数日的大火，厂区内人员被疏散
description: In the Frisian town of Drachten, a fire has been burning inside a silo for days, belonging to the company Agrifirm.
description_zh: 在弗里斯兰省德拉赫滕镇，属于 Agrifirm 公司的一个筒仓内发生火灾，已经持续燃烧数日。

title: Foundation sues Odido over February data breach affecting 6 million accounts
title_zh: 基金会就2月份影响600万个账户的数据泄露事件起诉Odido
description: The foundation Consumers United in Court (CUIC) has gone to court with a mass claim involving more than 500,000 participants against Odido over the major
description_zh: 消费者联合诉讼组织（CUIC）已就一项重大诉讼向法院提起诉讼，该诉讼涉及超过50万名参与者，被告为Odido公司。

title: Former Erasmus MC ICU chief to return in 3 months after resigning over critical report
title_zh: 因一份批评性报告而辞职的前鹿特丹伊拉斯姆斯医学中心重症监护室主任将在3个月后重返工作岗位
description: Diederik Gommers, the physician whoresignedthis week as head of the intensiv

title: DNA match links baby found dead in 1976 to two siblings 50 years later
title_zh: DNA比对结果显示，1976年发现的婴儿死亡与50年后发现的两名兄弟姐妹有关。
description: An investigation by The Hague police’s cold case team resulted in a DNA match between a deceased baby found in August 1976 and two men who were abandoned as infants around the same time.
description_zh: 海牙警方冷案小组的调查结果显示，1976 年 8 月发现的一名婴儿尸体与大约在同一时期被遗弃的两名婴儿的 DNA 相匹配。

title: Dutch households will pay more for water next year; Amsterdam to see 23% increase
title_zh: 明年荷兰家庭将支付更多水费；阿姆斯特丹的水费涨幅将达23%。
description: Drinking water companies across the Netherlands are raising their rates to pay for investments in water infrastructure as demand continues to grow.
description_zh: 随着需求持续增长，荷兰各地的饮用水公司正在提高水价，以支付水利基础设施的投资。

title: Dutch PM Jetten to challenge Trump over proposed U.S. restrictions on ASML

description: Prime Minister Rob Jetten plans to raise U.S. restrictions on ASML with President Donald Trump during next month's G20 summit in Miami.
description_zh: 总理罗布·杰滕计划在下个月于迈阿密举行的G20峰会上向美国总统唐纳德·特朗普提出美国对ASML的限制。

title: Netherlands not obliged to help Palestinians in Gaza travel to country, court rules

description: The Dutch government has no legal obligation to assist people living in the Gaza Strip who want to travel to the Netherlands, a court in The Hague ruled on Friday.
description_zh: 海牙一家法院周五裁定，荷兰政府没有法律义务帮助居住在加沙地带并希望前往荷兰的人们。

description: The Netherlands has relaxed its drone-flying restrictions, allowing hobbyists and professional drone operators to fly in significantly more areas around five civilian airports.
description_zh: 荷兰放宽了无人机飞行限制，允许业余爱好者和专业无人机操作员在五个民用机场周围的更大区域内飞行。

title: Nearly 1,000 reports of aggressive green-product sales such as heat pump, battery
title_zh: 近千份报告显示，绿色产品（例如热泵、电池）的销售存在激进的趋势。

description_zh: 自8月以来，荷兰业主协会Vereniging Eigen Huis已收到近1000份举报，内容涉及热泵、家用电池和隔热材料等产品的激进和误导性销售。

title: Netherlands to expand deposit system to include plastic juice and milk bottles
title_zh: 荷兰将扩大押金制度，涵盖塑料果汁瓶和牛奶瓶。

title: DSM-Firmenich among three firms fined 574 million euros over fragrance cartel
title_zh: 帝斯曼-菲美意等三家公司因香水卡特尔被罚款5.74亿欧元

title: Amsterdam hospital OLVG to close its Oost-location's emergency room

description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹 OLVG 医院正在将其所有急诊护理服务整合到一个地点，该地点位于 Nieuw-West 区 A10 环路旁。

title: No crime in man's death in Utrecht freezer; Family starts fundraiser for funeral

title_zh: 气温一夜之间降至零下8.1度；11月27日创下有史以来最低气温纪录。

description_zh: 昨晚荷兰气温骤降，多个气象站记录到11月27日有史以来最低气温。

description_zh: 住房公司联盟（Aedes）希望在社会住房优先分配问题上采取更加细致入微的方法。

title: MPs want to block provinces from shooting stray cats
title_zh: 议员们希望阻止各省射杀流浪猫。
description: A majority in parliament wants the Cabinet to take action against the shooting of stray cats. The province of Friesland, in particular, culls stray cats to protect other animals.
description_zh: 议会多数议员希望内阁采取行动，制止射杀流浪猫的行为。特别是弗里斯兰省，为了保护其他动物，会捕杀流浪猫。

title: Netherlands to return two 18th-century rifles looted from Sri Lanka
title_zh: 荷兰将归还从斯里兰卡掠夺的两支18世纪步枪

title: AI use by Dutch politicians increases workload for municipal officials, study finds

description_zh: 根据一项调查显示，随着民选政治家越来越多地使用人工智能来起草动议和提交问题，荷兰市政官员的工作量正在增加。

description_zh: 荷兰污水中检测到的新冠病毒颗粒物浓度已攀升至疫情爆发以来的最高水平，自10月中旬以来，测得的浓度上升了七倍多。
